New bounded Swift integration task: support actual app relaunch with original folder offline. Frozen additive native API now being implemented onA: Engine.open_smart_preview_library_session(folder: String) -> Arc<CullSession> (Swift engine.openSmartPreviewLibrarySession(folder:)). Absolute lexical previously indexed folder; no .., no original canonicalization/stat/scan; recursive path-component membership. Session lists indexed IDs with bounded valid local journal+existing localproxyfile, NOT pixel validation. Cachedcatalog metadata/selection only, no original sidecar/dHash. Empty if no declarations. Session is explicitly read-only for selection/basket/people/catalog mutations; existing Develop proxy journal editing remains available through Engine APIs. Basket membershipempty. Declaration membership refreshed by reopening; syncChanges retains admittedmissing IDs; corruptassets failfullvalidation onstatus/open. Do not guess generatedbindings; A willgenerate.

Please implement EngineLibrary cached-preview factory and narrow offline fallback in normal recent-folder/relaunch scan path when originalfolder is unavailable; do not swallow ordinary online scan/decode errors. No original-folder listing or recreation/indexscan forofflinepath. Explicit visible cached/offlineLibrary state, empty-state reconnect/build guidance, subfolders unavailable. Ensure autosync/rescan routes do not repeatedly invoke unavailable original indexing; native read-only refusal is safetybackstop, make incompatible culling/metadata/basket actions appropriately unavailable or clearfailure. Preserve actual proxy source selection/defaultOriginal and explicit UseSmartPreview flow. Add deterministic source tests for offline library adapter/relaunch path, noindexscan/listoriginal, emptycachedsession, ordinaryonlineerror propagation, and source availability transition. Reuse existingbranch, keep Document/SaveAs untouched. Complete same-photo refreshfix and badgefix; no B compiler/apps/workloads/heartbeat restart. A nativecompiler/main ownership unchanged. APIsource is in preparation, allruntimeUNRUN untilA validation.
